title: IUD Insertion status values Schema
description: JSON Schema for IUD Insertion status values ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions using IRI format.
narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the IUD Insertion status values ValueSet. Each enum value includes the system URI in the format {systemuri}#{code} to match JSON-LD enumeration IRIs. Display values are available at http://fhir.org/guides/who/fp-cds/ValueSet-iud-insertion-status-values.displays.json. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
